extraction.text:
Kriti Goel

Senior Process Excellence Manager

Ph. No- +918851-732058	Gurugram

Email: kriti039@hotmail.com                                                                                                                                                                LinkedIn

Forward-thinking Process Excellence Manager with proven track record of leading cross-functional teams to streamline operations and drive continuous improvement. Adept at identifying opportunities for process optimization and implementing strategic initiatives that enhance productivity and efficiency. Known for articulate communication skills and ability to inspire and motivate team members to achieve ambitious objectives. Proactive in seeking innovative solutions and committed to exceeding organizational goals.

SKILLS

Process Excellence & Transformation		Customer Experience Strategy		Microsoft Office Proficiency

Audit Governance & Compliance		Risk & Control		Microsoft Visio Expertise

Strategic Change Management		Team Leadership & Capability Building

EXPERIENCE

SENIOR PROCESS EXCELLENCE MANAGER

Cashify

Gurugram

November 2023 - Present

Centralized Process Repository: Architected and built a comprehensive process repository covering critical business lines (Warehouse Operations, Buyback Workflows); defined end-to-end protocols to align actual operational execution with compliance standards.

Lean Six Sigma Mentorship: Designed and led a Yellow Belt Certification Program, training and mentoring cross functional teams on high-impact efficiency projects, including Inventory Management and Delivery Partner Cost Reduction.

Audit & Compliance Leadership: Leading the internal compliance framework for external certifications; successfully managed audits for ISO 9001, 14001, 45001 and R2v3 (Responsible Recycling) standards. Additionally, overseeing Retail Mystery Audits to ensure store-level operational excellence.

External Audit: Serving as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for external PWC Audits, ensuring seamless coordination and 100% adherence to regulatory requirements.

Customer Experience Strategy: Spearheaded a successful C-SAT Improvement project, driving an increase in score from 3.3 to 4.0. Currently leading a strategic initiative to improve Product Net Promoter Score (NPS) at the store level.

Inventory Lifecycle Management: Optimization of end-to-end inventory flow (Incoming to Outgoing). Reduced turnaround time by identifying bottlenecks in Quality Check (QC) and Sales, ensuring 'stuck' devices are moved to the correct workflow.

Strategic Reporting: Designed and implemented the Monthly Retail Summary Report, synthesizing data from multiple audit sources (Store/Warehouse) to provide leadership with actionable insights on operational health.

ASSISTANT MANAGER PROCESS EXCELLENCE

Encore Capital Group

Gurugram

November 2021 - November 2023

Process Modeling & Workflow Optimization: Created detailed process flows and maps to identify bottlenecks; fixed critical workflow gaps to convert 'stuck' inventory into workable status.

Project Management: Drove high-impact strategic projects including critical Process Migrations (US to India) and the launch of 'Noble' and 'Bank Garnishment' process and workflow.

Knowledge & Team Management: Managed a team of Process Trainers and owned the end-to-end governance of Process Documents; standardized SOP creation to ensure 100% process compliance.

Stakeholder Management: Partnered with US-based Attorneys, Paralegals, and cross-functional teams to align process objectives.

Key Achievement: Received the Team Excellence Award (2023) for the smooth migration of processes from the US to India.

GROUP MANAGER - OPERATIONS

Encore Capital Group

Gurugram

August 2018 - October 2021

Team Leadership: Managed a team of 15-20 Account Managers, consistently driving them to exceed monthly targets and P75 goals.

Performance Turnaround: Led a strategic turnaround project for a Bottom Quartile cohort of 10 AMs; successfully coached 2 members into the 'Top 5' rank globally while elevating the remaining members to above-average performance.

Performance Coaching: Applied Situational Leadership models to conduct structured monthly reviews, optimizing individual development and retention.

Key Achievement: Honored with the President's Award (2018 & 2019)-an all-expense-paid trip to Hawaii awarded to the top 32 employees globally and the Value Champion Award (2021) for driving innovation.

OPERATIONS COORDINATOR / PROCESS TRAINER / ACCOUNT MANAGER

ENCORE CAPITAL GROUP

Gurugram

February 2014 - August 2018

Process Automation (RPA): Collaborated with the RPA team to automate the 'Placement to Suit to Court' workflow, successfully reducing manpower requirements from 90 to 40 FTEs.

Workflow Optimization: Identified and fixed critical state-level workflow gaps and 'Jurisdiction Fallout' issues to minimize operational leakage.

MIS & Reporting: Created essential leadership reports (State Performance, Affidavit Reports, Attorney Rejection) to support strategic decision-making.

Process Training & SOPs: Served as a dedicated Process Trainer for New Hire batches; designed and standardized SOPs for the Legal Suit Selection process to ensure consistency.

Started tenure as an Account Manager executing the Legal Suit Selection process, consistently meeting targets before advancing to Process Trainer and Ops Coordinator roles.

Key Achievements: Won the Spike on the Ball Award (2019) for high-impact project work, the Impact Award (2017) for top performance, and multiple Value Champion Awards (2016, 2018) for collaboration.

TEAM COACH & SR. CUSTOMER CARE EXECUTIVE

HCL Technologies BSERV

Noida

April 2011 – May 2013

Mentorship: Served as a Team Coach, training new hires and mentoring peers to improve process quality and operational metrics.

Team Operations: Managed daily floor operations for British Telecom, including work allocation, attendance tracking, and performance monitoring to ensure SLA adherence.

EDUCATION

B.Com in Commerce

Sikkim Manipal University

Jun 2014

CERTIFICATIONS

Lean Six Sigma Black Belt - Benchmark Six Sigma		Lean Six Sigma Green Belt - Benchmark Six Sigma

Prosci Change Management		Situational Leadership II

ASSISTANT MANAGER PROCESS EXCELLENCE
Encore Capital Group
Gurugram
November 2021 - November 2023
Process Modeling & Workflow Optimization: Created detailed process flows and maps to identify bottlenecks; fixed critical workflow gaps to convert 'stuck' inventory into workable status.
Project Management: Drove high-impact strategic projects including critical Process Migrations (US to India) and the launch of 'Noble' and 'Bank Garnishment' process and workflow.
Knowledge & Team Management: Managed a team of Process Trainers and owned the end-to-end governance of Process Documents; standardized SOP creation to ensure 100% process compliance.
Stakeholder Management: Partnered with US-based Attorneys, Paralegals, and cross-functional teams to align process objectives.
Key Achievement: Received the Team Excellence Award (2023) for the smooth migration of processes from the US to India.
GROUP MANAGER - OPERATIONS
Encore Capital Group
Gurugram
August 2018 - October 2021
Team Leadership: Managed a team of 15-20 Account Managers, consistently driving them to exceed monthly targets and P75 goals.
Performance Turnaround: Led a strategic turnaround project for a Bottom Quartile cohort of 10 AMs; successfully coached 2 members into the 'Top 5' rank globally while elevating the remaining members to above-average performance.
Performance Coaching: Applied Situational Leadership models to conduct structured monthly reviews, optimizing individual development and retention.
Key Achievement: Honored with the President's Award (2018 & 2019)-an all-expense-paid trip to Hawaii awarded to the top 32 employees globally and the Value Champion Award (2021) for driving innovation.

ENCORE CAPITAL GROUP

Workflow Optimization: Identified and fixed critical state-level workflow gaps and 'Jurisdiction Fallout' issues to minimize operational leakage.
MIS & Reporting: Created essential leadership reports (State Performance, Affidavit Reports, Attorney Rejection) to support strategic decision-making.

Started tenure as an Account Manager executing the Legal Suit Selection process, consistently meeting targets before advancing to Process Trainer and Ops Coordinator roles.
Key Achievements: Won the Spike on the Ball Award (2019) for high-impact project work, the Impact Award (2017) for top performance, and multiple Value Champion Awards (2016, 2018) for collaboration.

HCL Technologies BSERV
Noida
